notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
description:
Activate Blasted Landscape's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasted Landscape ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Borborygmos ability, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Blasted Landscape and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
